purpose: Record the latest official NDMA county drought-bulletin availability for the 22 governed whole-county P22 ASAL geographies without promoting stale alert states as current.

freshness_policy.current_tolerance: reference month no more than two calendar months behind the build/as-of month
freshness_policy.reason: The latest county bulletins exposed by the official NDMA listing are June 2026. At a September 2026 as-of date, June is three calendar months behind and therefore outside the P22 current-label tolerance.
freshness_policy.national_control_treatment: The newer July 2026 national bulletin may be used only as a reconciliation/control source. Its alert state must not be inherited to counties.
